---
name: Empirical test result
about: You tested one of the untested claims on a real device
labels: empirical, help wanted
---

**Which claim** — see [VERIFICATION.md](../../VERIFICATION.md)

**Device and OS version**

**What you did** — exact commands, so someone else gets the same result

**What happened** — the actual output, not a summary

**Does it confirm or contradict the book?**

> These are the most valuable contributions to this repo. The book asserts six things
> from documentation that nobody has publicly demonstrated. A result either way is new
> information, and you will be credited in the chapter.
